headline: Indian Markets Prepare for Special Diwali Muhurat Trading 2026 Following Strong Rally

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Special Diwali Muhurat Trading session is scheduled today on domestic stock exchanges.
Indian benchmarks posted their best week in six years, with Sensex crossing 81,000 and Nifty reclaiming 25,000.
Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) stepped up buying, helping Indian equities buck global tech selloffs.
Traders and investors are analyzing historical 10- and 20-year Muhurat trading performance data.
whatHappening: Adani Enterprises announced annual capex plans of ₹35,000-40,000 crore over the next two years.
IOC plans to purchase crude oil and LPG ships to mitigate shipping risks arising from the West Asia crisis.
Media reports highlighted details of a ₹904-crore bank fraud case linked to Future Retail and Kishore Biyani.
Exchanges published specific timings, settlement rules, and guidelines for the Muhurat trading session.
summary: Indian stock markets are set for the festive Diwali Muhurat Trading 2026 session following a strong weekly rally. The Sensex recently surged past 81,000 while Nifty reclaimed 25,000 driven by revived FII inflows. Key stock-specific news includes major capex plans by Adani Enterprises and shipping fleet acquisitions by Indian Oil Corporation.
